brief:
Settlements across the West Bank have begun distributing drones to residents, Shehab Wire reported. The unmanned aircraft are intended for photography, reconnaissance, and monitoring of areas surrounding the settlement outposts. The distribution represents an expansion of surveillance capabilities within settler-controlled enclaves.

According to available information, the initiative is designed to strengthen settler presence and defensive coordination across the settlements. The drones will enable residents to conduct aerial monitoring of territory adjacent to their communities and document activity in surrounding Palestinian areas. Settlement authorities have framed the distribution as a support measure for residents living in the outposts.
